blocks.text: By accessing the Zscaler Adaptive Access Engine service, you provide Zscaler the right to process, use, reproduce, store, modify, and display the information from logs. For Adaptive Access Engine, logs are defined as follows:

blocks.item: Signal History: Security context signals received from Zscaler products such as Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and third-party security products that typically indicate a level of risk for a user or device.
Audit Logs: Activity records of configuration changes made in the Admin Portal and via the Adaptive Access Engine API.

blocks.text: Zscaler retains the Signal History for a rolling period of 90 days during the term of the subscription. Zscaler retains Audit Log information for a rolling period of 6 months during the subscription term.
When the subscription term ends or expires, the logs are deleted by Zscaler according to the applicable retention cycles.
